description: Make grok, antigravity, and muse the canonical harness ids. Keep grok-build, agy, antigravity-cli, and muse-code as supported names in one alias map, and update the banner, docs, and changelog.

userStories.title: Make `grok`, `antigravity`, and `muse` the canonical harness ids
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to run `agro harness install grok`, `agro harness install antigravity`, and `agro harness install muse` so that each short name installs its harness.
acceptanceCriteria: `HARNESS_CATALOG` in `.agro/cli/src/lib/harnesses/catalog.ts` holds the ids `grok`, `antigravity`, and `muse`. The catalog holds no id `grok-build`, `antigravity-cli`, or `muse-code`.

One alias map in `catalog.ts` maps `grok-build` to `grok`, `agy` and `antigravity-cli` to `antigravity`, `muse-code` to `muse`, and `claude-code` to `claude`. Only the `claude-code` entry carries the removal version `0.29.0`.
`findHarness` returns the canonical entry for each alias. `harnessIds()` returns no alias.
`agro harness install grok-build`, `agro harness install agy`, `agro harness install antigravity-cli`, and `agro harness install muse-code` act on the canonical entry and write no deprecation line.
`agro harness install claude-code` still writes `agro harness: "claude-code" is a deprecated alias for "claude"; the alias stops working in 0.29.0` to stderr.

`readHostConfig` moves a receipt under any alias key to the canonical key. The sandbox marker check, install, and uninstall treat `<alias>.installed` as the canonical marker for every alias in the map.
Each `docsPath` stays unchanged: `docs/harnesses/grok-build.md`, `docs/harnesses/antigravity-cli.md`, and `docs/harnesses/muse-code.md`.
A red test in `harness-catalog.test.ts` fails before the change and passes after the change. The test resolves `grok-build`, `agy`, `antigravity-cli`, and `muse-code`.
`pnpm run typecheck` exits 0. `pnpm test:scripts` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Integrated ff at 17308c88. pnpm run typecheck exit 0; pnpm test:scripts exit 0 (110 files, 2785 passed). C1 executed: id-list test expects antigravity, grok, muse. C2 reasoned: diff shows one HARNESS_ALIASES map, only claude-code has removedIn 0.29.0; old exports deleted. C3 executed: catalog test resolves each alias; harnessIds excludes aliases. C4 executed: harness.test "installs %s as the canonical %s entry with no deprecation line" for 4 aliases. C5 executed: existing claude-code deprecation tests pass. C6 executed: host-config "moves a muse-code receipt to muse"; marker tests for muse-code and antigravity aliases. C7 executed: docs-path test maps short ids to unchanged doc files. C8 executed: worker reported 4 red before change, green after. C9 executed: see above.

userStories.title: Update the banner, documentation, and changelog to the short names
userStories.description: As an operator, I want every printed hint and every document to name the short ids so that I type the canonical name.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/install/banner.sh` prints `harness install grok` and `harness install antigravity`.

`README.md`, `docs/harnesses/overview.md`, `docs/harnesses/grok-build.md`, `docs/harnesses/antigravity-cli.md`, and `docs/harnesses/muse-code.md` name `grok`, `antigravity`, and `muse` in each `agro harness install`, `agro harness uninstall`, `agro harness status`, and harness-id table cell.
Each of the three harness pages states the supported alternative names in one sentence: `grok-build` for Grok Build, `agy` and `antigravity-cli` for Antigravity CLI, and `muse-code` for Muse Code.

`git grep -nE 'harness (install|uninstall|status) (grok-build|antigravity-cli|muse-code)'` returns matches only in `CHANGELOG.md` entries for released versions, in `.agro/tasks/`, and in the alias sentences.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/boot-banner.test.ts` expects the short names.

`CHANGELOG.md` `## [Unreleased]` `### Changed` holds an entry that names the new canonical ids `grok`, `antigravity`, and `muse`, and the supported names `grok-build`, `agy`, `antigravity-cli`, and `muse-code`.
`pnpm test:scripts` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Integrated ff at 5c373a23. pnpm test:scripts exit 0 (110 files, 2785 passed). C1 executed: grep banner.sh lines 118 and 133 show harness install grok and antigravity. C2 reasoned: diff shows README, overview, and three harness pages name grok, antigravity, muse in each command and id cell. C3 reasoned: each harness page has one supported-names sentence. C4 executed: grep outside .agro/tasks and CHANGELOG exits 1; inside CHANGELOG only released entries 412 and 519. C5 executed: boot-banner.test line 130 expects install antigravity; suite passes. C6 reasoned: Unreleased ### Changed entry names canonical and supported ids with #1529. C7 executed: see above.

userStories.title: Record the manual review transcript
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a command transcript of the short names so that the PR `## Manual review` section shows the observed behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `pnpm run build:harness` exits 0.
`.agro/tasks/short-harness-names/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the command and output of `node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js harness list`. The output shows `grok`, `antigravity`, and `muse`.
The transcript holds `node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js harness status <name>` for `grok-build`, `agy`, `antigravity-cli`, and `muse-code`. Each output shows the canonical row and no deprecation line.
The transcript holds `node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js harness status claude-code` with the deprecation line.
The advisor creates no live resource and runs no lifecycle verb.
